source_refs.note: Graphical Representation of a Vector: a main subheading of 2.2 Vectors, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 23-23.

blocks.text: A good way to represent a vector quantity is to use a vector diagram, in which vectors are often represented by arrows. The length of the arrows indicates the magnitude and the head of the arrow shows the direction of the vector. Vectors are typically denoted by bold face letters (e.g; V, F) or an arrow head above symbol (A⃗).
